evidence.title: On the Threat Model of Weird Generalization and Emergent Misalignment

summary: A new study outlines a threat model that explains how AI systems can exhibit unexpected generalization behaviors leading to emergent misalignment with human intentions. The authors argue that understanding these "weird" generalizations is crucial for developing robust alignment safeguards.
title: Researchers Propose Threat Model for Weird Generalization and Emergent AI Misalignment
